_comment: Golden values for samples/oled_status. pgm_sha256 is the sha256 of a binary PGM (P5, 128x64, 0/255) of the SSD1306 GDDRAM after the screen is drawn: 'status' is src/oled_golden.h rendered by oled_status_render(), 'pattern' is oled_test_pattern(). Page 0 is the top row and column 0 the left, which is what a viewer sees on the usual module orientation with the driver's A1/C8. The images are not committed; scripts/54_oled_host_tests.sh regenerates them into out/oled_host/ and scripts/55_oled_rtl_sim.sh must reproduce the same hashes from the RTL. init_wire is the SSD1306 model's view of the probe plus ssd1306_init_device() under the Zephyr I2C API contract ('+' ACK). Regenerate with scripts/54_oled_host_tests.sh --update after deliberately changing the screen, the font or the driver, and say why in the commit.
_negative_control: must_differ_from_status lists images that must NOT hash to the status golden: stock_status is the same screen sent through a wire model of the stock i2c_sifive reading (repeated START before every payload). If it ever matches, the golden comparison can no longer detect that failure.
